description: Add a job to the user's Auto Apply list by its application link (careers sites, referrals, shared links). Links in the job library map to that job; others are shown by domain until the company and title are identified in the background. Optionally choose the resume. Replies with the application as read back, including its id. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)
name: add_job_link_to_apply_list
